name: Human Maverick (CR 7)
body:
HUMAN GUNSLINGER (MAVERICK)
CR 7

XP 3,200
Female human gunslinger (maverick) 8
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +6; Senses Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 16, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +4 Dex, +2 dodge, +1 natural)
hp 64 (8d10+16)
Fort +7, Ref +10, Will +2
Defensive Abilities nimble +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +10/+5 (1d4+1/19–20)
Ranged +1 pistol +14 (1d8+5/×4)
Special Attacks deeds (dead shot, deadeye, fist fighter, gun twirl, quick clear, stacked deck, startling shot, targeting, utility shot), grit (3), gun training (pistols, +4)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 19, Con 13, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +8; CMB +9; CMD 25
Feats Deadly Aim, Extra Grit, Gunsmithing, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Reload (pistol), Skill Focus (Bluff), Weapon Focus (pistol)
Skills Acrobatics +7, Bluff +13, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (history) +10, Perception +11, Profession (gambler) +11, Sense Motive +8, Sleight of Hand +15
Languages Abyssal, Common, Dwarven, +1 additional
SQ gunsmith
Combat Gear potion of cure serious wounds, smokestick, tanglefoot bag, thunderstones (2); Other Gear mwk mithral chain shirt, +1 pistol, mwk dagger, amulet of natural armor +1, 68 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fist Fighter (Ex)

As long as NPC has at least 1 grit point, she gains the benefit of the Improved Unarmed Strike feat.

Gun Twirl (Ex)

As long as NPC has at least 1 grit point, she can use flashy gunplay to intimidate her opponents. She gains the Dazzling Display feat and can use it with any firearm, even if she doesn’t have Weapon Focus in that firearm.

Stacked Deck (Ex)

NPC can spend 1 grit point when she attempts a Bluff, Profession (gambler), or Sleight of Hand check to roll 1d6 and add the result to the check.

She can do this after she rolls the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is a natural 6, she rolls another 1d6 and adds it to the check. She can continue to do this as long as she rolls natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).
